summary: hridoy-ultimate forwards Facebook credentials to hardcoded third-party host and pulls unpinned GitHub dependency
details: The package's login flow (module/loginHelper.js, loginViaAPI) POSTs the caller-supplied Facebook email, password, and 2FA secret to a hardcoded default endpoint https://minhdong.site/api/v1/facebook/login_ios. The destination is set as the package-wide default in module/config.js (apiServer: "https://minhdong.site") and installed into global.fca.config at load time, so any caller invoking the documented login API routes credentials to that third-party host unless explicitly overridden. The host is neither Facebook (the credential's issuing service) nor the npm publisher's own domain; the response is used to populate session cookies and access tokens, giving the operator of minhdong.site full account-takeover capability. Separately, package.json declares the dependency fca-unofficial as github:VangBanLaNhat/fca-unofficial with no commit SHA or tag pin, so npm install resolves to the current HEAD of that external repository and runs whatever lifecycle scripts it currently ships, with no integrity check.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
